species.tagline: A common orange butterfly in Hong Kong gardens

tasks.title: Look at the wings
tasks.message: Orange wings, with black tips dotted in white.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a plain tiger. Orange wings with white-spotted black tips.

tasks.title: It tastes bad on purpose
tasks.message: As a caterpillar it eats poisonous leaves, so birds find it horrible and leave it alone.
tasks.subtitle: It ate poisonous leaves as a caterpillar, so birds learn to leave it alone.

tasks.title: Help it
tasks.message: Flowers in the garden are what it feeds on.
tasks.subtitle: Flowers are what it feeds on. Thank you!
